recipes.title: Spicy Cauliflower & Chickpea Curry

recipe.title: Spicy Cauliflower & Chickpea Curry
recipe.description: A hearty vegan curry featuring urgent cauliflower, protein‑rich chickpeas, and warm garam masala, served with fluffy basmati rice.
instructions: Rinse the dried chickpeas, place them in a bowl, cover with water and soak for at least 4 hours (or overnight).
Drain and rinse the soaked chickpeas, then add to a pot with 600 ml fresh water. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 35 minutes, until tender; set aside.
While the chickpeas cook, cut the cauliflower into florets and roughly chop the tomatoes.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté 5 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic (3 cloves) and fry 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the cauliflower florets, tomatoes, and 2 tsp garam masala; cook 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower begins to brown at the edges.

Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer. Add the cooked chickpeas, season with 1 pinch salt, and cook 10 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender and the sauce thickens.
Serve hot with basmati rice.
tips: If you run short on time, use canned chickpeas (drained and rinsed) – they count as a pantry ingredient you’ll need to buy.
Adjust spiciness with a pinch of red chili powder or fresh green chilies (optional).
recipe.image_prompt: Professional food photography, vibrant cauliflower and chickpea curry in a copper pot, steam rising, garnished with fresh cilantro, side of fluffy basmati rice, warm natural light

issues: L'étape 8 mentionne de servir avec du riz basmati sans préciser la quantité à cuire ni la méthode de cuisson.
La recette utilise des ingrédients absents du garde-manger (oignon, ail, lait de coco) sans justification d'achat.
La quantité de riz n'est pas définie dans les ingrédients.
strengths: La gestion du temps de trempage et de cuisson des pois chiches est cohérente.
Les repères de cuisson (translucide, doré, tendre) sont bien intégrés.

recipes.title: Crispy Spiced Potato & Tomato Biryani

recipe.title: Crispy Spiced Potato & Tomato Biryani
recipe.description: A fragrant one‑pot biryani using potatoes, fresh tomatoes, and basmati rice, seasoned with garam masala and aromatic spices.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear; soak for 15 minutes, then drain.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1‑cm cubes. Roughly chop the tomatoes.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a heavy‑bottomed pot over medium heat. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds; fry 30 seconds until they sizzle.
Add the potato cubes, sprinkle with a pinch of salt, and sauté 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes turn golden and start to crisp.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, 0.5 tsp turmeric, and 1.5 tsp garam masala; cook 4 minutes, until the tomatoes soften.
Add the drained rice, gently mix to coat the grains with the spices, then pour in 500 ml water. Bring to a boil over medium‑high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer 15 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Turn off the heat, let the biryani rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately.
tips: For extra crunch, reserve a handful of fried potato cubes and sprinkle them on top just before serving.
If you prefer a milder flavor, reduce the amount of garam masala or omit the turmeric.
recipe.image_prompt: Close‑up food photography of golden crispy potatoes and tomato biryani in a deep pan, speckled with garam masala, steam curling, rustic wooden table

issues: La recette utilise des ingrédients non listés dans le garde-manger (cumin, curcuma, coriandre fraîche).
La quantité de riz est précisée dans les ingrédients mais la méthode de cuisson est un peu sommaire pour un biryani.
strengths: L'ordre des étapes est logique et permet une exécution fluide.
Les repères de cuisson sont excellents (riz rincé jusqu'à eau claire, pommes de terre dorées).

recipes.title: Cauliflower & Tomato Steamed Dumplings (Momo) with Chickpea Filling

recipe.title: Cauliflower & Tomato Steamed Dumplings (Momo) with Chickpea Filling
recipe.description: Light, steamed dumplings inspired by Nepali‑Indian street food, using urgent cauliflower and chickpeas for a protein‑packed filling, served with a tangy tomato‑garam masala dipping sauce.
instructions: Rinse the dried chickpeas, soak them in water for 4 hours, then drain.
Place the soaked chickpeas in a pot, cover with fresh water and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook 20 minutes, until just tender. Drain and let cool.
Finely grate the cauliflower (use the urgent half‑head) and squeeze out excess moisture with a clean kitchen towel.
Finely chop the green onion, mince the garlic, and dice the tomato.
In a bowl combine the cooked chickpeas, grated cauliflower, green onion, garlic, tomato, 1 tsp garam masala, and a pinch of salt. Mix well; the mixture should be moist but hold together.
To make the dough, whisk 200 g all‑purpose flour with 80 ml water and a pinch of salt until a smooth, non‑sticky dough forms. Knead for 2 minutes, then let rest 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12 equal balls. On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into a 8‑cm circle, thinner in the center.
Place 1 tbsp of filling in the center of each wrapper, fold over, and pleat the edges to seal tightly.
Arrange the dumplings in a steamer basket, ensuring they do not touch. Steam over boiling water for 12 minutes, until the dough becomes translucent and the filling is hot.
For the dipping sauce, blend the remaining tomato with 1 tsp garam masala, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp vegetable oil until smooth. Serve the sauce alongside the hot momos.
tips: If you have leftover cooked rice, you can add 2 tbsp to the filling for extra body.
To keep the dumplings from sticking, line the steamer with parchment paper punched with holes.
recipe.image_prompt: Artistic shot of steamed cauliflower‑chickpea momos on a bamboo steamer, with a small bowl of bright tomato‑garam masala sauce, soft steam, rustic setting

issues: La recette utilise de la farine et des oignons verts non présents dans le garde-manger.
L'étape 2 demande de cuire les pois chiches 20 minutes, ce qui est insuffisant pour des pois chiches secs après seulement 4h de trempage.
La sauce à base de tomate crue mixée manque de cuisson pour être réellement appétissante.
strengths: La technique de façonnage des dumplings est bien expliquée.
L'utilisation du chou-fleur râpé est une excellente idée anti-gaspi.
